title: Lukas Van Ness fined for hit on Carson Wentz, no fine for hit on Kyler Murray

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Lukas Van Ness fined for hit on Carson Wentz, no fine for hit on Kyler Murray
sources.description: Packers linebacker Lukas Van Ness was involved in the Week 1 play that ended with Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffering a concussion, but the only fine for a hit on a quarterback from that game stemmed from a different play.
